back_translation: I will stand at my watch post and station myself on the rampart; I will keep watch to see what He will say to me, and what I shall answer concerning my complaint.
Then the LORD answered me: 'Write down this vision and inscribe it clearly on tablets, so that the one who reads it may run to carry the message.'
For the vision still awaits the appointed time; it bears witness to the end and will not lie. Though it lingers, wait for it, for it will surely come and will not delay.
Behold, the proud one—his soul is not upright within him; but the righteous will live by his steadfast faith.

Moreover, wine betrays the arrogant man; he will have no rest. He widens his greed like Sheol, and like death he is never satisfied. He gathers all the nations to himself and sweeps up all the peoples as his own.

Will not all these nations take up a taunt against him, with mockery and riddles of derision, saying: 'Woe to him who amasses what is not his own—how long?—and loads himself down with goods taken in pledge!'
Will not your creditors suddenly rise up, and those who make you tremble awaken? Then you will become plunder for them.
Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you—because of the blood of men, and the violence you did to the land, to the city, and to all who dwell in it.
Woe to him who gains unjust profit for his house, to set his nest on high, to escape the grasp of disaster!
You have devised shame for your house by cutting off many peoples, and you have sinned against your own life.
For the stone will cry out from the wall, and the beam will answer it from the woodwork.
Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and founds a town with injustice!
Behold, is it not from the LORD of Hosts that the peoples toil only for fire, and the nations weary themselves in vain?
For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
Woe to him who makes his neighbor drink, pouring out his wrath until he is drunk, in order to gaze on their nakedness!
You are filled with shame instead of glory. Drink, you too, and expose your nakedness! The cup in the LORD's right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

For the violence you did to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the beasts will terrify you—because of the blood of men, and the violence done to the land, to the city, and to all who dwell in it.
What use is a carved idol, since a craftsman carved it? It is only a cast image and a teacher of lies, for its maker trusts in what he himself has formed, making idols that cannot speak.
Woe to him who says to the wood, 'Awake!' and to the silent stone, 'Arise!' Can these things teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, but there is no breath within it at all.
But the LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.
